description: Get the full published, anonymised background of one successful 500/600/485/820 visa case by its public id from search_visa_cases, including case highlights, processing duration, advisor and canonical website link. Offer cases are excluded. Cite the returned url; an individual case does not predict another applicant’s result. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

id.description: The public id returned by search_visa_cases (not the internal caseId).

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

name: get_visa_case
title: Get a successful visa case
